name: gym-tracker-api
description: The backend API for the gym macro tracker: owns macro targets, food log entries, workout logs, coach invites/links and coach feedback. Persists to its own Postgres database and verifies the gateway's signed assertion for every non-public operation. Food macros are entered by the Trainee directly — this service does not call any external nutrition data source. Does not render any UI and does not itself talk to Thunder except to verify tokens.
